terminal_reference_pose: Actual offline configuration supplying the terminal reference's orientation; measured fingertip retained for rendering. The QP reference instead uses the exact target position and zero velocities.
snapshot: After 100 applied controls, before the 101st action; stored index 100.
time_axis: Predictions anchored at measured states 100 and 101, with future outputs at 101-110 and 102-111 respectively. Orange: actual recorded closed-loop measurements at display times 100-110 (trace y/distance indices 99-109). Planned-input panel: plan at 100, inputs at 100-109, not the later inputs actually applied under replanning.
measured_anchor_connectors: First point of each forecast curve is the measured output, not the slack-adjusted fitted past output.
interpretation: Horizon forecasts versus actual receding-horizon measurements. Only the first planned action is applied before replanning; this is not a same-input open-loop model-validation comparison or an isolated causal attribution to rank, bounds, slack, or horizon length.
format: Times New Roman 9 pt, STIX math, original paper palette and axes styling; vector PDF and 300-dpi PNG.
